title: Laminations for Transformers and Inductors for Use in Telecommunication and Electronic Equipment, Part 2: Preferred Ranges of Laminations, Section 7: Lamination Type YM-1
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11794 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Laminations for Transformers and Inductors for Use in Telecommunication and Electronic Equipment, Part 2: Preferred Ranges of Laminations, Section 7: Lamination Type YM-1.
clause_3_terminology: Laminations for Transformers and Inductors for Use in Telecommunication and Electronic Equipment

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
